content: ABC News has officially introduced Searched, a livestreamed show that highlights stories people are discussing on social media and searching on the web, as reported earlier by Variety. Though the network just announced the show now, Searched began airing on the ABC News Live streaming channel in April, which appears on both Disney Plus and Hulu. In the press release, ABC News says Searched “pulls real-time data from the top search engines and social media platforms to provide topical news for the audience.” A recent episode of Searched highlighted an Illinois Powerball winner, NBA star Russell Westbrook’s retirement, and Tropical Storm Lala. You can find a backlog of episodes on the ABC News YouTube channel. ABC News is introducing the streaming-only segment as broadcast TV viewing continues to decline, and a growing number of people turn to social media to get their news. The half-hour program is hosted by ABC News correspondents Gio Benitez and Ashan Singh, and has a new episode each weekday. [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qrZgU4cvFbA&list=PLQOa26lW-uI_k3QB0OUxq9WpXi8sOUCTi&index=2] Searched will appear alongside three other new shows on ABC News Live, including All Access with Linsey Davis, featuring interviews with celebrities, politicians, athletes, and influencers; Burden of Proof, which will highlight “the most talked-about trials”; and Doctor’s Note, a series focused on highlighting medical facts and health trends. In addition to embracing live news, many streaming services are filling out their lineups with live sports and shows. Disney Plus is also exploring adding a free streaming tier, something Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos said the streamer will “continue to consider.”

chineseContent: 据 Variety 早些时候报道，美国广播公司新闻频道 (ABC News) 正式推出了 Searched，这是一个直播节目，重点介绍人们在社交媒体上讨论和在网络上搜索的故事。尽管该网络现在刚刚宣布该节目，但 Searched 已于 4 月份开始在 ABC 新闻直播频道上播出，并出现在 Disney+ 和 Hulu 上。美国广播公司新闻在新闻稿中表示，Searched“从顶级搜索引擎和社交媒体平台提取实时数据，为观众提供时事新闻”。最近一集《Searched》重点介绍了伊利诺伊州强力球冠军、NBA 球星拉塞尔·威斯布鲁克的退役以及热带风暴拉拉。您可以在 ABC News YouTube 频道上找到积压的剧集。随着广播电视收视率持续下降，越来越多的人转向社交媒体获取新闻，美国广播公司新闻频道正在推出纯流媒体部分。这个半小时的节目由美国广播公司新闻记者吉奥·贝尼特斯和阿山·辛格主持，每个工作日都有新一集。 [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qrZgU4cvFbA&list=PLQOa26lW-uI_k3QB0OUxq9WpXi8sOUCTi&index=2]《Searched》将与 ABC 新闻直播中的另外三档新节目一起出现，其中包括《All Access with Linsey Davis》，其中包括对名人、政治家、运动员和影响者的采访；举证责任，将突出“最受关注的审判”；以及《医生笔记》系列，重点强调医学事实和健康趋势。除了直播新闻之外，许多流媒体服务还通过直播体育赛事和节目来充实自己的阵容。 Disney Plus 还在探索增加免费流媒体服务，Netflix 联合首席执行官特德·萨兰多斯 (Ted Sarandos) 表示，该流媒体公司将“继续考虑”。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
